title: DNS register inscription body
description: JSON inscription body only. This object is valid solely as the content of an ord envelope (text/plain names need no JSON). The same bytes in an OP_RETURN, including any DNS1|reg|… pipe string, are not a registration.

op.description: reg is an alias of register. config/update/upd are a different inscription and are not this schema.

name.description: label.namespace — SNS UTF-8 charset (emoji ok); one dot; no spaces
